fields.claim: Walls thicken uniformly at fixed radius, with peak stress as 1/wall. 051's FE is not re-run at the thickened walls, and the hail stress power fit (wall exponent -1.13 to -1.30) is carried from 051's 0.98-3.6 mm walls to as much as 17 mm.
fields.needed_to_ground: Re-run 051's frame FE and hail model at the sized walls.
